targetName: 打铁运营机制看板目标

query.filter: CAST(`日期` AS STRING) = '2026-07-01' AND TRIM(`品牌`) = 'MG'
query.rawRowsSql: SELECT CAST(`日期` AS STRING) AS `日期`, TRIM(`品牌`) AS `品牌`, TRIM(`大区`) AS `大区`, TRIM(`小区`) AS `小区`, TRIM(`经销商`) AS `经销商`, TRIM(`车系`) AS `车系`, CAST(`订单目标` AS DOUBLE) AS `订单目标`, TRIM(`大区代码`) AS `大区代码`, TRIM(`小区代码`) AS `小区代码`, TRIM(`经销商代码`) AS `经销商代码` FROM `打铁运营机制看板目标` WHERE CAST(`日期` AS STRING) = '2026-07-01' AND TRIM(`品牌`) = 'MG' ORDER BY `大区`, `小区`, `经销商`, `车系`, `大区代码`, `小区代码`, `经销商代码`
query.aggregateMethod: Local sum of 订单目标 from all 2026-07-01 MG u32 output rows after trimming string fields. rawRows persists all ten queried fields, including the u32 business dealer name 经销商; blank-code rows are real u32 output rows and remain in the sum.

responseAudit.businessCodeNote: With raw-backend-response=TRUE, this successful endpoint returns preview/columns JSON without a business code field; success is gated by HTTP 200, no error_code/error, exact expected columns, isTruncated=false, rowCount, local aggregates and SHA-256.

hash.scope: canonical JSON.stringify(rawRows) in query column order

differenceAudit.method: Difference rows are the extra u32 rows retained by the ETL one-to-many join on dealer short name. All persisted audit rows now include the u32 business dealer name 经销商.

cases.explanation: One upload dealer short name matched three MG dimension rows; the two extra matched dealer codes each repeated the same 69 target.
One dealer short name exists under two MG dealer codes. Because the ETL join does not include district, each district target is matched to both codes, creating 36 + 36 extra target.
